name: F&F Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: F&F Holdings Co., Ltd. is a prominent entity in the fashion industry, primarily operating through its various subsidiary companies. Its core activities involve the design, production, and sale of clothing and a diverse range of accessories. Beyond manufacturing and sales, the company's extensive portfolio also includes wholesale and retail distribution, brand licensing, strategic investment ventures, and the provision of management consulting and logistics services. This South Korean firm, headquartered in Seoul, was established in 1972.
